data.title: Exclusive-US, China gear up for mid-September AI safety talks
data.description: By Laurie Chen BEIJING, Sept 4 (Reuters) - The U.S. and China are gearing up to discuss AI safety risks during a dialogue planned for mid-September, two sources briefed on the discussions told Reuters
